description: Read the signed-in user’s notification channel switches and per-event preferences. Shows the four groups update_notification_preferences replaces and the switches set_notification_channel toggles. Use get_notifications to list the notifications themselves.
name: get_notification_settings

EMAIL.description: Account-wide email switch; while false, no event group is delivered by email

IN_APP.description: Account-wide in-app switch; while false, no event group is delivered in-app

mentions.description: Channels (PUSH, EMAIL, IN_APP) for mentions in posts; [] turns it off

newFollowers.description: Channels (PUSH, EMAIL, IN_APP) for new followers; [] turns it off

subscribedAuthorPost.description: Channels (PUSH, EMAIL, IN_APP) for new discussion posts in streams the user owns; [] turns it off

system.description: Channels (PUSH, EMAIL, IN_APP) for system notices, such as subscription, export and access updates; [] turns it off

title: Read notification settings
